response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(f.rebtotal) as overall_avg_rebate FROM fees f WHERE f.orderslink IS NOT NULL),combo_stats AS (SELECT f.orderslink,o.ordertune,AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate,AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_relative_gap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.orderslink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune)SELECT cs.orderslink,cs.ordertune,cs.avg_rebate,cs.avg_relative_gap,cs.avg_rebate - oa.overall_avg_rebate as margin_above_average FROM combo_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE cs.avg_rebate > oa.overall_avg_rebate ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
